findings.statement: D4 is a case report of fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP); it describes a sixteen-year-old male patient with classic features of FOP who presented with pain and swelling in his upper back after a biopsy had been performed two months earlier, and who at age 9 developed tender stiffness of the shoulders and neck, followed over the next 4 years by multiple similar upper-back swellings with subsequent limitation of shoulder and neck movement and progressively growing masses.
